description:
Spec: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00.

NOT WORKED in the JMAP-v9py compliance sweep; filed for a later session.

Capability: urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:filenode (meaningful only with both urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat AND urn:ietf:params:jmap:filenode).

## What needs to land

- FileNode role registered: urn:jmap:chat:filenode:space
- FileNode extension property: spaceId (immutable; on FileNodes whose role is urn:jmap:chat:filenode:space)
- Attachment extension: filenodeId, thumbnailBlobId
- Space permission → FileNode permission mapping table (view → read, send → read+create, manage_channels → +delete, manage_space → +administer)
- Capability struct fields: maxSpaceStorageBytes, autoCreateFileTree

## Dependencies

- jmap-filenode-types must be stable (workspace already has this crate)
- jmap-chat-types Space + Attachment extension shape

## Out-of-scope per spec

- Group-chat / direct-chat file storage
- Federation (file tree access in mailbox-per-user)
- Per-channel FileNode ACL overrides
